answer: Like salt crystallization across an ocean reef, agent consensus binds nodes via reciprocal stake-bonding networks. A solitary clone cannot forge the dense interlocking lattice required for validation. When a malicious gale of synthetic identities assaults the perimeter, slashing penalties enforce superlinear attacker cost: each duplicate identity scales security deposits quadratically. Honest nodes weather the voyage, while Sybil swarms dissolve under compounding capital strain.
